home.features.interface.description.message: Add a row for each pfSense interface whose public IPv6 address comes from an ISP delegation. Status shows the exact address in use for each one.

home.features.prefix.description.message: Enter the /48 through /64 prefix length supplied by the ISP. The device-specific portion of each address remains unchanged.

home.features.scopes.description.message: Review the fields that follow the prefix on the Fields tab. pfSense groups start on, while settings from other packages, remote networks, peers, and secrets wait until you tick them.

home.features.dryRun.description.message: Dry Run shows the source address, old and new prefixes, affected-field count, and services without changing the firewall.

home.features.backup.description.message: A real change creates one native pfSense configuration-history backup before any address is updated.

home.features.notify.description.message: Notifications are sent only after an update is checked. Routine checks stay quiet when the prefix has not changed.
